JDownloader 4.9.5 gets its weekly refresh working again, so the image keeps up with Ubuntu's security fixes.

## ⚡ Improved

- **Updated base image:** the LinuxServer Selkies base moves to its latest build. It brings Ubuntu's current fixes, among them OpenJDK 21.0.13, glibc, Perl, libheif and GStreamer.
- **Updated build tools:** the Temurin JDK that compiles the helper agent and the Dockerfile syntax (now 1.29) are on their latest releases, and so are the shared CI workflows.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **The weekly rebuild runs again.** It rebuilds the newest release without the layer cache so the image picks up the base's security fixes. It asked the builder to skip the cache and to skip it for one stage at the same time, which the builder refuses, so every rebuild failed and the published image fell behind. The rebuild now skips the cache as a whole.
